final_message:
Configured the 31-zone DNS hierarchy, including delegations, glue, requested A and MX records, and a recursive resolver on pc32. All 40 PCs now point to that resolver. The existing topology, addresses and routes were preserved.

The baseline had no configured web service, so `www.example.com` points to pc33’s existing address, `10.15.9.11`. The DNS change does not start a web service.

Static checks passed for all zones, delegations and client resolver settings, and all startup scripts passed shell syntax checks. Runtime DNS queries could not be tested because Docker access was unavailable. The lab image must contain BIND 9’s `named`; see [DNS.md](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-l0c_kypy/lab/DNS.md) for details and query examples.
